extracted.intended_audience: undergraduate creative writing instructors, program assessors, and course designers (Indiana University South Bend / similar US undergraduate programs)
extracted.subtask_description: Rubric for assessing undergraduate creative writing (fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction) with dimensions covering language facility, voice, genre awareness, creativity, craft, and mechanics; includes scoring scales and recommended weightings for program/course assessment. Intended to guide instructors evaluating student creative work and program-level assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility with Language
rubrics_metrics.description: Diction precision; Sentence rhythm; Syntactic variety; Control of register; Avoidance of cliché.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses command of words and sentence-level craft — precise word choice, varied syntax and cadence, appropriate register, and avoidance of clichéd phrasing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style and Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinctive; Consistent; Appropriate to subject; Recognizable; Earned (not imitative).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether the piece exhibits a unique, believable voice that suits the material and feels authentically developed rather than derivative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sense of Genre and Tradition
rubrics_metrics.description: Knowledge of conventions; Awareness of predecessors; Productive engagement with form; Originality within tradition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures understanding of genre conventions and literary traditions and the ability to work within or productively against them — showing awareness of predecessors while contributing original work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity and Originality
rubrics_metrics.description: Unexpected angles; Fresh treatment of familiar material; Risk-taking with form/voice/subject; Avoidance of the obvious.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on the novelty of ideas, approaches, and risks taken in form or voice; rewards departures from predictable choices and inventive perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic Insight
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive depth; Issues addressed with seriousness; Complexity of moral/philosophical engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses the depth and seriousness with which themes are treated, including moral or philosophical complexity rather than superficial treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Plot architecture; Causal momentum; Pacing; Resolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates story-building elements: coherent plot structure, believable causal movement, effective pacing, and satisfying or purposeful resolution (as appropriate to the piece).

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of Lyric Meditation (for poetry/CNF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustained reflective stance; Image patterns; Resonance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For lyric forms (poetry, lyric creative nonfiction), judges the poem/fragment's ability to sustain reflection, deploy resonant images and patterns, and create lingering emotional or intellectual effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reflection on Craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Self-awareness of choices; Articulation of decisions; Evidence of revision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Looks for metacognitive evidence — the writer's ability to explain or show why craft choices were made and clear signs that the piece has been revised with intention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mechanics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers technical correctness and adherence to formatting. Noted as having less weight than craft categories but still required; mechanical failures can impede readability and lower scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common Scoring Scale
rubrics_metrics.description: 4–6 levels: Beginning / Developing / Proficient / Strong / Exemplary OR letter-grade-aligned: F / D / C / B / A.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides typical ordinal scoring options for assessing each rubric dimension; individual programs may map levels to numeric scores or letter grades for course/program assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical Note on Weighting
rubrics_metrics.description: Many academic rubrics weight non-creative elements (mechanics, organization, structure) at >50% of the score, even though 'the primary purpose of creative writing is creativity.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warns of a common tension in assessment between teachable/measurable elements (mechanics, structure) and artistic elements (creativity) and suggests awareness when designing weights and interpreting scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended Weighting (A Better Balance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per academic literature: 40–60% creativity/voice/originality; 20–30% craft execution; 10–20% mechanics/format; 10% revision evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggested allocation of overall grade weight to better reflect the primacy of creativity while still valuing craft and technical correctness; usable as a model for course- or program-level grading schemes.
